There isn’t one permanent “best” free model in Kilo Code — the catalog rotates, and Kilo’s own guidance is to treat rankings as live, not fixed. As of today, here’s the practical answer.

## Best default: **Auto Free** (`kilo-auto/free`)

For most people, this is the right choice. It routes each request to the best currently available free model, so you don’t have to chase the leaderboard every week.

- Zero cost, no API key
- **200 requests/hour per IP** rate limit
- Tradeoff: prompts may go to providers that log data (NVIDIA free endpoints, etc.) — not for confidential code

## Best manual picks (if you want a specific model)

From [Kilo’s free models page](https://kilo.ai/landing/free-models):

| Model | Why pick it |
|-------|-------------|
| **Hy3 (free)** | Highest **KiloBench** score among tested free models (~47.6%). Best bet if you want the top benchmarked free option. |
| **Nemotron 3 Ultra (free)** | Strong agentic/reasoning model, **1M context** (largest free context), popular in real Kilo usage. |
| **Ling-3.0-flash (free)** | Token-efficient MoE model; high real-world usage in Kilo Code. Good for everyday edits. |
| **Laguna S 2.1 (free)** | Strong coding-agent scores (e.g. Terminal-Bench), newer Poolside model. |
| **Nemotron 3 Super (free)** | Lighter Nemotron option if Ultra feels slow. |

## By task

- **General coding / debugging** → **Auto Free**, or **Hy3** if you want to pin one model
- **Long files / big context** → **Nemotron 3 Ultra**
- **Fast, lightweight edits** → **Ling-3.0-flash** or **Ling-2.6-flash**
- **Agent workflows** → **Nemotron 3 Ultra** or **Ring-2.6-1T**

## What I’d actually do

1. Start with **Auto Free**.
2. If you like the workflow but want more control, open the model picker, filter by `free`, and try **Hy3** or **Nemotron 3 Ultra**.
3. Check [kilo.ai/landing/free-models](https://kilo.ai/landing/free-models) occasionally — it updates about every 60 seconds.

**Bottom line:** Use **Auto Free** unless you have a reason to pin a model. If you’re pinning, **Hy3** for quality or **Nemotron 3 Ultra** for long-context agent work are the strongest free options right now.

If you tell me your use case (quick edits vs. big refactors vs. agent loops), I can narrow it to one pick.
